1. Jalan Bintulu-Tanjong Kidurong (Laluan 800)

Dari simpang di km. 722.50 (diukur dari Sematan) di Laluan 1

melalui Jalan Bintulu−Miri ke Bulatan Tanjong Kidurong

di km. 725.50 (dari Kuching), Jalan Tanjong Kidurong ke

Pelabuhan Bintulu di km. 741.00.

Jarak sepanjang 18.50 km.

2. Jalan Pintas Kuching (Laluan 801)

Dari persimpangannya dengan Laluan 1 di km. 106.10 (diukur dari

Sematan) melalui Jalan Datuk Bandar Mustapha ke Bulatan BDC di

km. 107.75 melalui Jalan Tun Jugah ke Jejambat Simpang Tiga di

km. 111.10 melalui Jalan Tun Razak ke Bulatan Pending

di km. 115.20.

Jarak sepanjang 9.10 km.

3. Jalan Datuk Mohd. Musa (Laluan 802)

Dari persimpangannya dengan Jalan Badar Kota Samarahan

di km. 0.00 ke simpang UNIMAS di km. 5.57 melalui bulatan jalan

masuk ke Pasar Batu 7 di km. 20.35 dan berakhir di km. 20.74, ke

persimpangan Bulatan di km. 112.20 (diukur dari Sematan) di

Laluan 1.

Jarak sepanjang 20.74 km.

4. Lebuh Raya Pan Borneo: Jalan Serian−Tebedu-Sempadan Indonesia

(Laluan 21)

Dari Sempadan Sarawak−Indonesia di km. 0.00 ke Pasar Tebedu di

km. 3.50, melalui Jalan Tebedu-Tebekang ke Pasar Tebekang di

km. 19.70 dan berakhir di km. 35.20 dan Jalan Tebekang-Serian di

Bulatan Serian (km. 156.60 diukur dari Sematan) di Laluan 1.

Jarak sepanjang 35.20 km.

5. Jalan Masuk ke Politeknik Kuching (Laluan 901)

Dari simpang di km. 17.94 di Jalan Matang (diukur dari hujung

Jambatan Satok, Kuching) dan sepanjang jalan masuk ke Politeknik

Kuching di km. 19.74.

Jarak sepanjang 1.80 km.".

Pindaan Senarai II Jadual Kedua

3. Senarai II Jadual Kedua Perintah ibu dipinda di bawah kepala Negeri Sarawak

dengan memotong butiran 5, 6 dan 8.

Pindaan Senarai III Jadual Kedua

4. Senarai III Jadual Kedua Perintah ibu dipinda di bawah kepala Negeri Sarawak

dengan memotong butiran 6 dan 7.

Dibuat 5 September 2012

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/16 Jld.2; PN(PU2)460/LXVII]

DATO' SERI SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

 Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

WEIGHT RESTRICTIONS (FEDERAL ROADS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Weight Restrictions (Federal Roads)

(Amendment) Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 12 September 2012.

Amendment of List I of Second Schedule

2. The Weight Restrictions (Federal Roads) Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 478/1989], which

is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in List I of the Second

Schedule―

(a) by inserting after the heading State of Perlis the following:

"STATE OF SARAWAK

1. Bintulu-Tanjong Kidurong Road (Route 800)

From the junction at km. 722.50 (measured from Sematan) at

Route 1 via Miri−Bintulu Road to the Tanjong Kidurong

Roundabout at km. 725.50 (from Kuching), Tanjong Kidurong

Road to Bintulu Port at km. 741.00.

A distance of 18.50 km.

2. Kuching Bypass (Route 801)

From its junction with Route 1 at km. 106.10 (measured from

Sematan) via Datuk Bandar Mustapha Road to BDC Roundabout at

km. 107.75 via Tun Jugah Road to Simpang Tiga Flyover

at km. 111.10 via Tun Razak Road to Pending Roundabout at km.

115.20.

A distance of 9.10 km.

3. Datuk Mohd. Musa Road (Route 802)

From its junction with Bandar Kota Samarahan Road at km. 0.00 to

the junction of UNIMAS at km. 5.57 via the roundabout access road

to Pasar Batu 7 at km. 20.35 and ended at km. 20.74, to the

junction at the Roundabout at km. 112.20 (measured from

Sematan) at Route 1.

A distance of 20.74 km.

4. Pan Borneo Highway: Serian−Tebedu Road−Indonesia Border

(Route 21)

From Sarawak−Indonesia Border at km. 0.00 to Tebedu Bazaar at

km. 3.50 via Tebedu-Tebekang Road to Tebekang Bazaar

at km. 19.70 and ended at km. 35.20 and Tebekang-Serian Road at

Serian Roundabout (km. 156.60 measured from Sematan)

at Route 1.

A distance of 35.20 km.

5. Approach Road to Kuching Polytechnic (Route 901)

From the junction at km. 17.94 at Matang Road (measured from

the end of Satok Bridge, Kuching) and along access road to the

Kuching Polytechnic at km. 19.74.

A distance of 1.80 km.".

Amendment of List II of Second Schedule

3. The List II of the Second Schedule of the principal Order is amended under the

heading State of Sarawak by deleting item 5, 6 and 8.

Amendment of List III of Second Schedule

4. The List III of the Second Schedule of the principal Order is amended under the

heading State of Sarawak by deleting item 6 and 7.

Made 5 September 2012

[KKR.110-1/6/16 Jld.2; PN(PU2)460/LXVII]

DATO' SERI SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

 Minister of Works
